court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Family Court in Execution Petition No. 23/2019
case_name: Parikshit Sahebrao Thakre Thr. Poa Mr. ... vs Poonam Parikshit Thakre
facts_of_case: Parties filed joint petition for divorce under Section 13(B) of the Hindu Marriage Act. They arrived at settlement terms and the Family Court passed a divorce decree with a rider that the petitioner husband would pay monthly maintenance.

legal_principles.principle: The Executive Court cannot directly issue an arrest warrant.
legal_principles.held: It is submitted that there is no source of power for the Executive Court to directly issue the arrest warrant.

legal_principles.principle: A divorce decree's terms, including maintenance, do not survive remarriage.
legal_principles.held: The term of providing maintenance would not survive, for which the petitioner has filed proceeding for revocation of a divorce decree in particular term of providing the maintenance.

outcome.final_order: The execution of the impugned order stands stayed, provided the petitioner complies with his undertaking to deposit 50% amount of arrears within two weeks.
